newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 954 million yuan from Wednesday's 1.54 billion with the 60-day contract still the most active one.
Traders said that confused expectations of a cut in bank interest rates kept trading dull.
One trader said it was possible the central bank would cut bank interest rates this year as inflation stays low.
But a second trader said Dai Xianglong, the governor of the central bank, had said in Hongkong last week that the government was not preparing for a cut in bank interest rates.
"The market is waiting for a clear direction and further falls in volume are likely in the next few days," he said.
